import pathlib,json,subprocess,os,hashlib,re
p=pathlib.Path('/root/storage-probe');r=json.loads((p/'guarded-execution.json').read_text())
org=r['organization'];assert re.fullmatch('execution_probe_[0-9]+',org)
assert len(r['results'])==7
def run(args,**kw):return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,timeout=30,**kw).strip()
def kube(*args):return json.loads(run(['k3s','kubectl',*args,'-o','json']))
def sql(query):return run(['sudo','-u','postgres','psql','accontrol','-At','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c',query])
r['database_counts']={t:int(sql(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {t} WHERE organization='{org}'")) for t in ['execution_requests','execution_dispatch_intents','execution_pod_plans','execution_pod_observations','execution_watchdog_arms','execution_startup_grants','candidate_writer_leases','candidate_writer_drains','candidate_writer_completions']}
assert r['database_counts']==dict(execution_requests=7,execution_dispatch_intents=7,execution_pod_plans=6,execution_pod_observations=6,execution_watchdog_arms=5,execution_startup_grants=5,candidate_writer_leases=7,candidate_writer_drains=0,candidate_writer_completions=0)
r['database_states']=json.loads(sql(f"SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('execution_id',e.execution_id,'execution_state',e.state,'writer_state',l.state,'epoch',l.epoch,'pod_uid',p.pod_uid,'grant_digest',g.grant_digest,'grant_pod_uid',g.pod_uid,'granted_at_ms',g.granted_at_ms,'grant_budget_ms',g.grant_body->'lease_budget_ms','arm_digest',w.evidence_digest,'registered_at_ms',w.registered_at_ms,'expires_at_ms',w.expires_at_ms)) FROM execution_requests e JOIN candidate_writer_leases l USING(organization,lease_id,epoch) LEFT JOIN execution_pod_observations p USING(organization,execution_id) LEFT JOIN execution_startup_grants g USING(organization,execution_id) LEFT JOIN execution_watchdog_arms w USING(organization,execution_id) WHERE e.organization='{org}'"))
assert all(x['execution_state']=='Unknown' and x['writer_state']=='Draining' for x in r['database_states'])
for row in r['database_states']:
 if row['grant_digest']:
  assert row['pod_uid']==row['grant_pod_uid'] and row['arm_digest']
  assert row['registered_at_ms']<=row['granted_at_ms'] and row['grant_budget_ms']<=row['expires_at_ms']-row['granted_at_ms']
r['database_durability']=json.loads(sql("SELECT json_build_object('fsync',current_setting('fsync'),'synchronous_commit',current_setting('synchronous_commit'),'full_page_writes',current_setting('full_page_writes'))"))
uids={x['pod']['pod_uid'] for x in r['results'] if x.get('pod')}
pods=kube('get','pods','-n','ac-kube-component')['items']
assert all(x['metadata']['uid'] not in uids for x in pods)
r['final_run_api_pods_remaining']=0
r['other_fixture_pods_at_collection']=[{'name':x['metadata']['name'],'uid':x['metadata']['uid'],'phase':x['status']['phase']} for x in pods]
first=r['results'][0]['pod']['manifest'];pvcname=next(x for x in first['spec']['volumes'] if x['name']=='workspace')['persistentVolumeClaim']['claimName']
r['kubernetes_objects']={'pvc':kube('get','pvc','-n','ac-kube-component',pvcname),'pv':kube('get','pv',r['volume_path']),'node':kube('get','node','ac-component-node')}
mount=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-juicefs/.config').read_text())
r['mount_configuration']={'filesystem_uuid':mount['Format']['UUID'],'storage':mount['Format']['Storage'],'writeback':mount['Chunk']['Writeback'],'fuse_writeback':mount['FuseOpts']['EnableWriteback'],'subdir':mount.get('Subdir','')}
r['environment']={name:run(args) for name,args in {'kernel':['uname','-r'],'k3s':['k3s','--version'],'runsc':['runsc','--version'],'juicefs':['juicefs','version'],'postgresql':['/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/postgres','--version'],'seaweedfs':['weed','version']}.items()}
r['remote_binaries']={name:hashlib.file_digest(open('/usr/local/bin/'+name,'rb'),'sha256').hexdigest() for name in ['execution_worker_live_test','agent-computer-server','agent-computer-watchdog','k3s','runsc','juicefs']}
r['node_configuration']=json.loads((p/'execution-config.json').read_text())['node']
pod_status=kube('get','pods','-n','kube-system')['items']
r['csi_images']=[{'pod':pod['metadata']['name'],'images':[{'name':x['name'],'image':x['image'],'image_id':x.get('imageID')} for x in pod.get('status',{}).get('containerStatuses',[])]} for pod in pod_status if pod['metadata']['name'].startswith('juicefs')]
cold=pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-guarded-cold');assert not os.path.ismount(cold);cold.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['META_PASSWORD_FILE']=str(p/'metadata-password')
args=['juicefs','mount','-d','--read-only','--no-usage-report','--cache-dir','memory','--cache-size','0','--buffer-size','64','postgres://jfsmeta@10.0.2.15:5432/jfsmeta?sslmode=disable',str(cold)]
mounted=subprocess.run(args,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=30)
(p/'guarded-cold.log').write_text(mounted.stdout);(p/'guarded-cold.log').chmod(0o600)
assert mounted.returncode==0,'cold mount failed; private log retained'
try:
 r['fresh_client_reads']=[]
 for case in r['results']:
  if case['case'] not in ['normal','command']:continue
  target=cold/r['volume_path']/case['prepared']['path_ref']/'output.txt';data=target.read_bytes();assert data==b'persisted'
  r['fresh_client_reads'].append({'case':case['case'],'bytes':len(data),'sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'inode':target.stat().st_ino})
 r['cold_cache']='new read-only client, memory cache, cache-size 0'
 r['object_get_metrics']=[s for s in (cold/'.stats').read_text().splitlines() if not s.startswith('#') and 'object' in s and 'get' in s.lower()]
finally:subprocess.run(['umount',str(cold)],check=True,timeout=15)
(p/'node-guarded-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'database_counts':r['database_counts'],'fresh_client_reads':r['fresh_client_reads'],'object_get_metrics':r['object_get_metrics']}))
